facts.fact: The Instituto Nacional de Normalizacao e Qualidade (INNOQ) is named as the national body that awarded an ISO 9001:2015 certificate to the National Institute of Health's finance area on 16 March 2026; the document names no IT or data standard.

systems.system: ISO 9001:2015 quality management system, INS finance area
systems.owner: Instituto Nacional de Saude (INS), certified by INNOQ

note: Certification is ISO 9001 quality management (also ISO 15189 and ISO 17043 for the laboratory, certifier not named), not an IT or data standard, so no certification fact; recorded as other.
